value.rationale: The fixed-ratio outer trap scale provides a physically interpretable one-parameter family of disordered exclusion channels in which the direction of nonlinear response changes exactly once. A closed coefficient, rigorous unique threshold, and two-site unit-multiplier obstruction classify a structurally motivated minimal phenomenon; neither general existence of rectification nor the exact sign switch is a textbook consequence of reflection asymmetry.
